花为什么会变成果实？: How does a flower become fruit?
让蜜蜂把合适的花粉带到樱桃花上，再看花里面慢慢发生什么。: Help a bee bring compatible pollen to a cherry flower, then see what happens inside.
先看花心，再看剖面。果实和种子分别从哪里长出来？: Look at the flower center and its cutaway. Where do fruit and seed develop?
花里藏着子房，子房里面有胚珠。先让蜜蜂带来合适的花粉。: The flower contains an ovary with an ovule inside. First let the bee bring compatible pollen.
花粉到了柱头上，这叫授粉。接下来，花粉管生长，帮助完成受精。: Pollen reaches the stigma: this is pollination. A pollen tube then grows and enables fertilization.
受精后，胚珠发育成种子，子房逐渐发育成果实。花瓣会慢慢凋落。: After fertilization, the ovule develops into a seed and the ovary into fruit. The petals fade.
成熟樱桃的果肉和硬果核来自子房壁；种子藏在硬果核里面。不是花瓣变成了樱桃。: Cherry flesh and the hard stone develop from the ovary wall. The seed is inside the stone. Petals do not turn into cherries.
以樱桃核果为例：相容花粉落到柱头是授粉，花粉管生长后才可能完成受精。通常受精后的: In a cherry, deposition of compatible pollen on the stigma is pollination; pollen-tube growth precedes fertilization. A fertilized ovule normally develops into a seed, and the ovary wall into the pericarp: outer skin, fleshy middle layer and hard inner stone. The stone is not the seed. Other fruits can include additional floral tissues, and some seedless fruits develop without fertilization.
画面假设花粉相容且授粉受精成功，没有模拟温度、水分、花粉数量和品种差异。每次点击: The model assumes compatible pollen and successful pollination and fertilization. It omits temperature, water supply, pollen quantity and cultivar differences. Clicks compress unequal periods of growth. Bees transport pollen; they do not directly make fruit.
花瓣落了，故事还在继续: The story continues after petals fall
樱桃不是花瓣变的。花里的子房长成果实，里面的胚珠长成种子。: A cherry does not come from petals. The ovary develops into the fruit, while an ovule develops into the seed.
找一找果实的“旧花痕迹”: Look for traces of an old flower
请大人陪你看樱桃的果柄，再看看苹果底部留下的萼片。不同植物形成果实的方式并不完全: With a grown-up, examine a cherry stalk and the remaining sepals at the bottom of an apple. Fruit development differs between plants.
时间经过压缩；拖动是回看记录，不是让植物倒着长。: Time is compressed. Scrubbing reviews observations; it does not make a plant grow backward.
花粉先落到柱头，再长出花粉管。它不是整粒钻进子房；花粉管把精细胞送向胚珠。: Pollen lands on the stigma before a pollen tube grows. The whole grain does not burrow into the ovary; the tube carries sperm cells toward an ovule.
蜜蜂身上的花粉随它一起靠近；只有接触柱头后，花粉才留在花上。: Pollen travels with the bee. It stays on the flower only after contacting the stigma.
